instruction: Stream a LibreOffice Impress presentation directly to a web browser as a live interactive WebGL application.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because LibreOffice Impress does not have built-in functionality to export or stream presentations as WebGL applications. Such conversion would require extensive development tools not available in the standard environment.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly identified as infeasible - LibreOffice Impress lacks native WebGL export/streaming capabilities
The 'infeasible' evaluator function is the appropriate handler for impossible tasks
Explanation in metadata accurately describes why this task cannot be completed in the OSWorld environment
